ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; the visible surface is predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white/light grey) discontinuities restricted to fine-scale linear and circular markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity distribution across 95% of the visible fluke area. High-intensity geometric discontinuities appear as scattered vertical/diagonal linear paths and small circular clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) distributed non-uniformly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated angle approximately 55 degrees at the visible vertex, though the base is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire posterior boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 3 and 12 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a distal convex sweep towards the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-relief, calcified organisms (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips; numerous secondary circular white scarring patterns (rosettes) are visible on the interior fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of parallel and intersecting white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on both lobes, most prominent in the medial regions, measuring between 10 and 150 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive localized barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips creating irregular, high-relief silhouettes; extensive superficial linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of heavy distal barnacle loading contrasted against a high-density matrix of linear scratches on an otherwise uniformly dark pigment base.
